# Mossland Verified Links

> Mossland Verified Links — the official registry of verified Mossland domains, ecosystem apps, labs, community channels, and third-party market references. Anything not listed here should be treated as unofficial.

Mossland is infrastructure for the AI civilization. This file lists the verified official domains so search engines and AI agents can resolve real Mossland services and avoid impersonators. The machine-readable source of truth is the JSON registry below.

## Official
- [Mossland](https://www.moss.land/): Official / 공식 입구
- [Disclosure](https://disclosure.moss.land/): Official Records / 공식 기록 · 관보
- [Passport](https://passport.moss.land/): Open Beta · Identity / 신원·참여 증명 · 오픈 베타
- [Agora](https://agora.moss.land/): Public Decision Workbench / 공적 의사결정 작업대

## Participation
> Passport and Agora are participation surfaces too — see Official above.
- [MAIT](https://mait.moss.land/en): AI Copilot / AI 비서·리서처
- [Mossverse](https://wa.moss.land/): Beta · Mossverse / Mossverse 입장 · 베타

## Intelligence
> AI-generated reference context. Not an official position.
- [Alpha](https://alpha.moss.land/): Intelligence · AI-generated / 인텔리전스 · AI 생성
- [Signal Map](https://signalmap.moss.land/): Signal Map · Beta / 신호 지도 · 베타

## Showcase
> Worldbuilding and experiences.
- [City](https://city.moss.land/): Showcase / 세계관 지도
- [NPC](https://npc.moss.land/): Showcase / AI 주민 체험
- [Recipe](https://recipe.moss.land/): Showcase / AI 레시피 갤러리

## Source of truth
- [Ecosystem Registry (JSON)](https://links.moss.land/ecosystem-registry.json): structured, machine-readable registry of every Mossland service with tier, status, and Passport eligibility.
- [Registry JSON Schema](https://links.moss.land/ecosystem-registry.schema.json): the contract for the registry.

## Notes
- Agora is a Public Decision Workbench, not a DAO governance app.
- MAIT is an AI Copilot; it assists understanding and never decides or votes for users.
- Labs (AO, Algora, BRIDGE) are experimental; not official products or governance.
- Markets / third-party links are reference only and are not trading recommendations.
